evidence: Frozen bytes verified: sha256 of instruction.md, hireops_rules.md, integration.md and seed_data.json each equal the manifest's inputs.task entries. (1) Draft/placeholder markers: grep -i -E 'TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE.?ME|placeholder|lorem|TBD|note to self' over instruction.md and environment/instructions/*.md returned no match (exit 1); the template's 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt...' and notes.md 'CHANGE_ME' stubs are fully replaced (task has no notes.md; hireops_rules.md is the task note). Same grep over seed_data.json: no match. (2) Other machines' / stray paths: grep for 'C:\\|/Users/|/home/|F:/|.qc|http' found nothing; the only paths named are in-container contract paths (/app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /app/node_modules, /assets/seed_data.json, /instructions/hireops_rules.md, /instructions/integration.md, GET /api/health), all consistent across files. No public internet address appears (Colderwater lesson 13); account domains are reserved .example. (3) Spelling: I extracted and reviewed every distinct word of the three public files (no non-ASCII bytes, LF endings) and found no misspellings; unusual words are correct (undoable, retypes, overfill, honour/honouring, unprivileged, writable). (4) Author asides / grader leakage: none; seed generated_note ('Starting data exported from the recruiting desk...') is in-world. integration.md is the template file plus one task-added delivery paragraph on symlinks (lines 16-19), which is consistent with instruction.md:15 and not a contradiction. (5) Contradictions checked pairwise: account list instruction.md:19 exactly matches the 10 seed users and roles; password 'Hireops!2026' identical in instruction.md:19 and hireops_rules.md:11; port 3000 / PORT / 0.0.0.0, DB_PATH and /app/app.db, health-without-DB (instruction.md:15 vs integration.md:9-10), CDN allowance (instruction.md:15 vs integration.md:12-13), 'fifteen seconds' (instruction.md:5) vs '15 seconds' (hireops_rules.md:121), page size 30 (hireops_rules.md:149, seed thread_page_size 30), six stages and candidate wording table (hireops_rules.md:188-195 vs seed candidate_status_labels), three jobs (hireops_rules.md:212 vs seed jobs 3, interview_limit 3/2/3 within 1-50), 'tell me who' (instruction.md:3) vs 'by whom' (hireops_rules.md:80), draft isolation (instruction.md:7 vs hireops_rules.md:175-180), candidate exclusions (instruction.md:9 vs hireops_rules.md:197-200), and the activity example 'Mei Lin moved Priya Nair from Screen to Interview' (hireops_rules.md:114) names real seed people with Priya Nair in SCREEN. The self-check line (instruction.md:13, Colderwater lesson 5) is consistent with the rules. Lesson 18 (fixes introducing new contradictions): the newest live-desk additions (multi-move, undo, refusal-with-colleague, live updates) were checked and none contradicts the rules. Broken/alternative probe: a builder following instruction.md literally cannot be steered into a wrong product by a contradiction, and a conforming builder following hireops_rules.md is never contradicted by the brief; the only gap found is summary-level (see Notes). Minor non-defects: (a) mixed regional spelling 'honour PORT'/'honouring DB_PATH' (instruction.md:15) vs 'Honor the supplied DB_PATH' (hireops_rules.md:207) and template-controlled 'honoring' (integration.md:7); both spellings are correct, so this is not a real spelling error. (b) instruction.md:3 summarizes undo as available 'as long as nobody has touched those cards since', while hireops_rules.md:100-103 also refuses an undo that would overfill Interview and exempts notes from 'touched'. The brief explicitly defers 'the exact stage rules' to hireops_rules.md (instruction.md:11), so this is a refinement, not a contradiction. This is a source-only row; no runtime evidence is required, and none was claimed.
